honors.title: HSF Scholar
honors.description:
Selected among a pool of 85,000+ applicants and named a Hispanic Scholar via the Hispanic Scholarship Fund (HSF), the nation's largest provider of college information and services for Latinx families.

HSF empowers Latinx families with the knowledge and resources needed to successfully complete higher education and provides scholarships and support services to exceptional Hispanic students.
honors.issuer: Issued by Hispanic Scholarship Fund · May 2019

honors.title: Princeton Prize in Race Relations Certificate of Accomplishment
honors.description: Recognizes and rewards high school students who have had a significant positive effect on race relations in their schools or communities through their volunteer efforts.
